Getting Here

36 Delama Boulevard, Mambourin VIC 3024

Driving Directions

From Princes Freeway (M1)

  • Take the Werribee / Hoppers Crossing exit from the Princes Freeway (M1)
  • Head south along Black Forest Road toward Mambourin
  • Turn onto Delama Boulevard — Mambourin Marketplace will be on your right

From Werribee / Wyndham Vale

  • Head south-west along Hoppers Crossing Road or Ballan Road
  • Continue onto Black Forest Road heading south
  • Turn onto Delama Boulevard into Mambourin

Parking

Free On-Site Parking

Mambourin Marketplace offers ample free car parking for all shoppers. The car park is accessible directly from Delama Boulevard.

  • Large open-air car park
  • Pram and wheelchair accessible spaces
  • Dedicated accessible parking bays near the main entrance
  • 6 dedicated EV charging bays

EV Charging

We have 6 dedicated electric vehicle charging bays located in the main car park. Check in-centre signage for their exact location.

Public Transport

Bus Services

Mambourin is serviced by local bus routes operating through the Wyndham area. Check the Public Transport Victoria (PTV) website or app for the most current route and timetable information serving Delama Boulevard and surrounding streets.

  • Check PTV for up-to-date bus timetables
  • Connections available to Werribee Station
